pae_path.description: Absolute path to the predicted-aligned-error file. Accepts AF2 PAE JSON, AF3 confidence JSON, or Boltz NPZ outputs depending on the upstream predictor.

pdb_path.description: Predicted complex structure (PDB or mmCIF) corresponding to `pae_path`.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure predictor (e.g. Boltz, Protenix). Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when omitted.

chain_a.description: Chain id for the first side of the interface (e.g. the target receptor).

chain_b.description: Chain id for the second side of the interface (e.g. the designed binder).

cutoff.description: PAE cutoff (in PAE-score units, Å-equivalent) for interface contact selection. Pairs with PAE above this value are excluded from the ipSAE score.

dist_cutoff.description: Inter-residue Cα distance cutoff in Å used to define the interaction interface.
